en: Dependent on a wholesome state accompanied by rapture, a state that is neither accompanied by rapture nor wholesome arises by way of root condition.
Dependent on a wholesome state not accompanied by rapture, a state that is neither accompanied by rapture nor wholesome arises by way of root condition.
Dependent on both a wholesome state accompanied by rapture and a wholesome state not accompanied by rapture, a state that is neither accompanied by rapture nor wholesome [arises]...
[It] arises by way of the root condition (*hetupaccaya*). Under the root condition there are three; ... [and so on] ... under the non-disappearance condition (*avigatapaccaya*) there are three.
Dependent on an unwholesome state accompanied by rapture (*sappītika*), a state that is neither accompanied by rapture nor unwholesome arises by way of the root condition.
Dependent on an unwholesome state not accompanied by rapture (*appītika*), a state that is neither accompanied by rapture nor unwholesome arises by way of the root condition.
Dependent on unwholesome states that are with zest and unwholesome states that are without zest, an unwholesome state without zest arises by way of root condition (*hetu-paccaya*).
There are three [answers] under root; ... pe ... three under non-disappearance. (The indeterminate root has exactly three conditions.)
